title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00139 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 04:00: Waited on brine prior displacing well to heavy fluid meanwhile continued servicing FWR PRS cleaned pits performed PMS
04:00 - 07:00: Waited on brine prior displacing well to heavy fluid meanwhile performed housekeeping worked on modification on encoder on drawworks. cleaned pits performed PMS
07:00 - 13:30: Prepared for displacing well to brine. Cleaned pits tanks) meanwhile performed PMS. performed housekeeping worked on drawworks prepared permits inspected TDS and TDS hoses tested bx3 elevator and rotator finished recieving brine from boat 13 30.
13:30 - 14:30: Prepared for displacing well to brine. Mixed 1. 19sg cacl2 brine and kill pill. Experienced foaming and lost suction from pit.
14:30 - 16:00: Flushed lines several times.
16:00 - 18:30: Prepared to displace well to brine. Mixed new kill pill. Meanwhile removed slick joint nut 4 in)
18:30 - 19:00: RIH with spear/grapple/pack-off assy to 26m and engage spear.
19:00 - 19:30: Performed TBT for displacing well
19:30 - 20:00: Checked and confirmed line up. Walked the lines.
20:00 - 20:15: Performed new TBT due to uncerntainty in operation. Confirmed line-up.
20:15 - 22:15: Staged up rig pumps and pumped 37,2m3 1,19sg cacl2 brine at 1200 LPM 156 bar. Lined up and pumped 10m3 1,19sg cacl2 kill pill. Pumped 48,2m3 1,19sg cacl2 brine at 1200 LPM. Pressure started to increase, then dropped again before increasing to 160 bar.
22:15 - 22:30: Flow checked well through open choke. Some backflow observed, then static. Continued monitoring well on trip tank.
22:30 - 23:15: Disenganged spear and pulled pack-off out of tubing. Displaced BOP to 1,19sg cacl2 brine.
23:15 - 23:45: Disconnected TDS. POOH with BHA. Checked tools and r/b BHA.
23:45 - 00:00: Rigged up to drain riser through a-annulus outlet on WH down tubing and returns through a-annulus).
